synopsis: ASPRS supplies a formal framework for evaluating geometric acceptance when virtual-scene tests require metric truth [f3912]. The glossary identifies the cited laser-scanning reference as the American Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing positional accuracy standards from 2024 [f13137]. Chapter 5 describes lidar as the most geometrically accurate of the compared site-creation methods, with directly assessable accuracy, citing ASPRS 2024 and USGS 2025 [f4208]. Photogrammetry can achieve measurable centimetre-level accuracy with control, referencing ASPRS 2024, but performs poorly on occluded surfaces [f4198]. Both photogrammetry and lidar are described as having mature accuracy frameworks; the supplied facts do not specify numerical acceptance thresholds for virtual scenes [f4294, f3912].
